climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: The third-largest wine-producing US state, with 99.9 percent of wine grape production in the dry eastern half, in the Cascade rain shadow with about 8 inches of rain and long sunlight hours. Irrigation is key. In the Columbia Valley, Cabernet Sauvignon leads plantings, followed by Merlot and Syrah.
